summary: You can now enable or disable admin accounts directly, and the request portal is easier to use.

new.title: Enable and disable admins
new.text: Admin accounts has Enable and Disable per row or selection. Disable & remove delegations keeps the account but takes its access away on the next run.

new.title: Your name and support mail on the portal
new.text: Settings > Access requests (RFA) sets the company name and support e-mail the request portal shows.

fixes.title: Request portal finds more people
fixes.text: The portal finds admins and consultants by admin account, contact e-mail or forward address, and sends the PIN where they read mail.

fixes.title: Smaller improvements
fixes.text: The Stop managing dialog says Stop managing instead of Delete, and the portal's sign-in page and header are clearer.
